measurement_limits: AI and frame measurements are inclusive elapsed time, including scheduling waits, not thread CPU time.
An AI turn dispatches all five AI seats; mean_per_ai_turn_ms divides by controller _ai_turn calls.
Whole-child GetProcessTimes CPU sums all Godot threads, including setup, snapshot capture and shutdown; it is not AI-stage CPU time.
Headless fixed-step synthetic midgame with no render-frame pacing; no GPU or rendered FPS claim.
Exact decision-frame checkpoints, first/final states and frame rule counts match; this is not a hash of every individual action event.
Detailed wrappers add instrumentation overhead; compare their call counts and attribution separately from plain timing runs.
Historical source/generated manifests are recorded by the runner before and after each run; receipt and raw artifact hashes are rechecked by this summarizer.

Stage-2 pig/frog/rabbit followups replace only those heroes' stage-1 performance conclusions. All original exact-state evidence is retained; other stage-1 cases retain their own recorded source hashes and results.

performance_risks.interpretation: The roughly 50 ms squirrel observation is not an upper bound for all heroes. Pig, frog and rabbit required separate followup evaluation; use their retained followup results for current performance claims.
performance_risks.followup_scope: Only pig/frog/rabbit private skill branches changed after stage 1, so those three heroes are rerun. The other stage-1 evidence retains its measured source revision.

manifest_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators and ensure_ascii=False
